highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.150.1 refreshes the bundled Skia m150 engine with two focused upstream bug fixes.
highlights_body: It corrects clipped render-pass stencil checks and prevents a use-after-free when deserializing corrupt Slug buffers.

bullets.detail: Checks clipped render-pass bounds against the cleared stencil area.
Fixes a use-after-free and possible wild or double free when a corrupt Slug buffer fails deserialization.

harfbuzz_summary: Updates the co-shipped HarfBuzzSharp from 14.2.1 to 14.2.1.1.
